fields.name: job_name
fields.label: Job name
fields.help: A label for this run and its results.

fields.name: pdb_path
fields.label: Protein structure
fields.help: PDB structure whose point mutations will be scored.
fields.help_note: Upload PDB text or choose the preset containing the official AlphaFold example structure.

fields.name: chains
fields.label: Chains to load
fields.help: Comma-separated PDB chains used as structural and sequence context, e.g. A,B,C. By default, substitutions are predicted for the first chain.

fields.name: chain_to_predict
fields.label: Chain to predict
fields.help: Optional chain whose substitutions are predicted. It is moved to the front of the loaded chain list; blank uses the first chain above.

fields.name: model_name
fields.label: ProteinMPNN model
fields.help: 48-neighbor ProteinMPNN checkpoint trained with the indicated backbone noise.

fields.name: seed
fields.label: Random seed
fields.help: Seed used to split the per-repeat JAX random keys.

fields.name: nrepeats
fields.label: Model repeats
fields.help: Run with this many keys split from the input seed and average the resulting predictions.

fields.name: without_ddG_correction
fields.label: Disable the ddG correction
fields.help: Write raw logit differences without the paper's single-residue ddG correction. The correction is defined only for v_48_020, so this must be enabled with every other model.

_comment: Field names and defaults follow predict.py. The service manages outpath. ProteinMPNN-ddG always scores every standard point mutation for one chain; top-k filtering is not part of its public CLI.
